title: Addition of binary prefix values
statement: Let $A,B:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be Boolean sequences, and let $i$ be a natural number. The sum of their values on positions below $i$, with position $j$ weighted by $2^j$, equals the corresponding weighted value of their bitwise sum below $i$, plus $2^i$ if the carry into position $i$ is true (and plus zero otherwise).
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are Boolean sequences indexed by natural numbers
